designDecisions.decision: Used the value label only to support an ambitious integrated estate programme with a resolved arrival, upper retreat, private pavilions, pool court, and outdoor lounge.
designDecisions.limitation: No valuation, cost estimate, market claim, or luxury certification is made.

designDecisions.decision: Established a dominant shared residence volume with subordinate private pavilions and an explicit arrival-to-water sequence.
designDecisions.limitation: The pavilions are reached across exterior circulation; no enclosed inter-wing corridor is modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Directed shared living, terrace, upper retreat, and pool court toward an assumed waterfront outlook while retaining separate private pavilion entries.
designDecisions.limitation: No surveyed shore, legal setback, flood datum, marine work, or actual waterfront is modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Combined deep flat roof planes, shaded glazing, timber screens, and a covered entrance as a tropical envelope intent.
designDecisions.limitation: Wind, rainfall, thermal, corrosion, and hurricane performance are not simulated or certified.

designDecisions.decision: Used the salon’s segmented glazed face and direct terrace connection to privilege the shared water-court outlook without glazing all elevations.
designDecisions.limitation: Glare and actual view analysis are not available.

designDecisions.decision: Built a physical limestone approach, paired portal posts, canopy, and actual central salon entry opening.
designDecisions.limitation: The canopy is an architectural shelter concept, not a structural or weatherproofing certification.

designDecisions.decision: Used separately editable, generously proportioned flat roofs over the salon, private pavilions, and upper suite.
designDecisions.limitation: Drainage, waterproofing, roof loading, and guard compliance are not modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Placed the upper floor over the main salon enclosure and created a ground-contact exterior stair/landing sequence for actual level access.
designDecisions.limitation: Geometric support contact is not structural-engineering verification.

designDecisions.decision: Used sheltered openings and stone-toned/bronze/timber material assignments as maintainable coastal-design intent.
designDecisions.limitation: Material enums do not establish corrosion resistance, fixing design, or hurricane detailing.

designDecisions.decision: Made a readable approach and threshold rather than assuming a street orientation.
designDecisions.limitation: Road alignment, cadastral access, grading, and setbacks are unknown.

designDecisions.decision: Retained the real portal posts, canopy, approach, and salon threshold.
designDecisions.limitation: Canopy structure and weatherproofing are not certified.

designDecisions.decision: Recomposed the salon low roof into two distinct flat side fields to preserve a deliberate upper-suite void.
designDecisions.limitation: Drainage, waterproofing, roof loading, and guard compliance are not modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Replaced the obstructed central stair with an exterior step-and-landing sequence at a consistent 0.206 m modeled rise.
designDecisions.limitation: Manual stair geometry is not a code, accessibility, handrail, or certified navigability assessment.

designDecisions.decision: Placed the upper access bridge in contact with the upper floor edge and supported its outer circulation walk using ground-contact volumes.
designDecisions.limitation: Geometric support contact is not structural-engineering verification.

limitations: Surface areas are per physical element; overlapping surfaces are not additional usable area. Enclosed area, requested-space completeness, pool construction and circulation require architectural review. A renderable model is not a completed building.
